reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Beta Panthenol Repair Gel Cleanser 120mL
reviews.text: The best cleanser I have used for my sensitive skin. Pairing it with toner and moisturizer helps keep my skin glowy and smooth. I had to bulk buy some. Love it
reviews.zh: 用過最適合敏感肌嘅潔面產品。配搭爽膚水同保濕霜一齊用，皮膚保持水潤光滑。我要大手入貨，愛上咗佢。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Beta Panthenol Repair Gel Cleanser 120mL
reviews.text: I love this product for face cleaning, not my first time buying it, is already part of my daily routine, does not leave my face oily and leaves a smooth skin experience
reviews.zh: 好鍾意用呢件產品洗面，已經唔係第一次買，已經加入咗我嘅日常護膚程序，用完塊面唔會油笠笠，仲有滑溜嘅感覺。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Beta Panthenol Repair Gel Cleanser 120mL
reviews.text: I have rosacea and very sensitive combination skin, and my skin reacts to almost any product🙂But this cleanser is honestly one of the best I’ve ever tried. It doesn’t dry out my skin or irritate it, and it cleans really well. The texture is gel-like and it foams nicely. I definitely recommend it and would repurchase it again🩵!
reviews.zh: 我有玫瑰痤瘡，係好敏感嘅混合性肌，皮膚對大部分產品都會有反應🙂但呢支潔面真係我用過最好嘅之一。佢唔會抽乾皮膚水分，又唔會刺激，仲清潔得好乾淨。質地似 gel，搓出嚟嘅泡沫都好綿密。真心推薦，一定會回購🩵！

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Beta Panthenol Repair Gel Cleanser 120mL
reviews.text: I love it! it is – it foams nicely and cleans really well. The scent is pleasant, and afterward my skin feels fresh and comfortable. I also like that it contains panthenol, which helps to moisturize, soothe, and strengthen the skin barrier.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意！佢嘅泡沬好細緻，而且清潔效果好好。氣味怡人，用完之後皮膚感覺清爽舒適。我亦都好鍾意佢含有泛醇，有助保濕、舒緩同強化皮膚屏障。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Beta Panthenol Repair Gel Cleanser 120mL
reviews.text: It has a faint scent similar to other panthenol products and doesn’t sting if it gets in your eyes. a bit weak for removing the day’s make up or sunscreen but great as a morning face wash since it is not harsh on the skin. the texture is pretty watery compared to all other cleansers i have tried.
reviews.zh: 佢有淡淡嘅氣味，同其他泛醇產品類似，唔小心入到眼都唔會刺痛感。對於卸除成日嘅彩妝同防曬就稍嫌力有不逮，但好適合做早上嘅洗面乳，因為佢對皮膚唔會太刺激。同我用過嘅其他潔面產品比起，質地算係好水。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Beta Panthenol Repair Gel Cleanser 120mL
reviews.text: I have been using this cleanser for 2 years. I have sensitive skin. I didn’t get any pimple outbreaks when using it. I like the milky texture too.
reviews.zh: 我用咗呢枝潔面產品 2 年。我係敏感肌，用緊期間冇爆過瘡。我亦都好鍾意佢嘅乳液質地。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Beta Panthenol Repair Gel Cleanser 120mL
reviews.text: I love this facial wash. It feels light and it doesn’t feel like my skin is squeaky clean but it feels moistened afterwards. It feels gentle to the skin as well
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢枝洗面乳。感覺好清爽，唔會有嗰種繃緊嘅乾淨感，但用完之後皮膚感覺有被滋潤到。對皮膚都好溫和。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Beta Panthenol Repair Gel Cleanser 120mL
reviews.text: For me, this cleanser failed to live up to all of its claims. It dried and stung my skin, foamed up SO much (even though it's a gel cleanser), and smelled like potpourri (it claims to have no fragrance). So disappointed.
reviews.zh: 對我嚟講，呢枝潔面產品完全達唔到佢聲稱嘅效果。佢令我皮膚變乾同刺痛，泡沬又多到不得了（雖然佢係標明係啫喱狀潔面），仲有種好似乾花咁嘅味道（佢聲稱係無香料）。非常失望。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
